# WebRTC's audio processing module (echo canceller AEC3, noise suppressor, AGC2, high-pass filter),
# cut out of WebRTC with only the files it needs. Abseil is used only through its headers.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

file(GLOB_RECURSE WEBRTC_APM_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS src/*.cc src/*.c)

set(WEBRTC_APM_X86 OFF)
if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(x86_64|AMD64|amd64|i.86|x86)$" OR CMAKE_GENERATOR_PLATFORM MATCHES "^(x64|Win32)$")
    set(WEBRTC_APM_X86 ON)
endif()
if(ANDROID AND NOT ANDROID_ABI MATCHES "x86")
    set(WEBRTC_APM_X86 OFF)
endif()

set(WEBRTC_APM_AVX2)
foreach(f ${WEBRTC_APM_SOURCES})
    if(f MATCHES "_avx2\\.cc$")
        list(REMOVE_ITEM WEBRTC_APM_SOURCES ${f})
        list(APPEND WEBRTC_APM_AVX2 ${f})
    elseif(f MATCHES "_sse2?\\.cc$" AND NOT WEBRTC_APM_X86)
        list(REMOVE_ITEM WEBRTC_APM_SOURCES ${f})
    endif()
endforeach()
if(WEBRTC_APM_X86)
    list(APPEND WEBRTC_APM_SOURCES ${WEBRTC_APM_AVX2})
    if(MSVC)
        set_source_files_properties(${WEBRTC_APM_AVX2} PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "/arch:AVX2")
    else()
        set_source_files_properties(${WEBRTC_APM_AVX2} PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-mavx2;-mfma")
    endif()
endif()

add_library(webrtc_apm STATIC ${WEBRTC_APM_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(webrtc_apm SYSTEM PUBLIC src absl_headers)
target_compile_features(webrtc_apm PRIVATE cxx_std_20)  # (its headers also work in C++17, which the rest uses)
set_target_properties(webrtc_apm PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON C_STANDARD 11 C_EXTENSIONS ON)
target_compile_definitions(webrtc_apm PUBLIC WEBRTC_APM_DEBUG_DUMP=0 WEBRTC_EXCLUDE_TRANSIENT_SUPPRESSOR RTC_DISABLE_TRACE_EVENTS)
if(WEBRTC_APM_X86)
    target_compile_definitions(webrtc_apm PRIVATE WEBRTC_ENABLE_AVX2)
endif()
if(WIN32)
    target_compile_definitions(webrtc_apm PUBLIC WEBRTC_WIN NOMINMAX WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN _USE_MATH_DEFINES)
    target_link_libraries(webrtc_apm PRIVATE winmm)
elseif(APPLE)
    target_compile_definitions(webrtc_apm PUBLIC WEBRTC_POSIX WEBRTC_MAC)
else()
    target_compile_definitions(webrtc_apm PUBLIC WEBRTC_POSIX WEBRTC_LINUX)
    if(ANDROID)
        target_compile_definitions(webrtc_apm PUBLIC WEBRTC_ANDROID)
        target_link_libraries(webrtc_apm PRIVATE log)
    endif()
    find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
    target_link_libraries(webrtc_apm PUBLIC Threads::Threads m)
endif()
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(webrtc_apm PRIVATE /w /bigobj /utf-8)
else()
    target_compile_options(webrtc_apm PRIVATE -w)
endif()
